ai_summary: Snapshot of the on-device AI in Snapchat 11.70.0.36: no DNN model ships in the APK. The bundled intelligence is classical computer vision from the Looksery lens engine inside libcamplat+.production.so: a Lienhart 20x20 Haar cascade for face detection, an LZC/zstd container of ERT landmark regressors (68/98 landmarks, eyes, denoise, Candide-3 3-D shape and perspective), two 256-bit ORB vocabulary trees for natural-feature tracking, and Scenarium GLES shaders plus landmark triangulations for AR deformation. Snap's newer AI Factory (Cameo/Bloop) stack, which uses MACE/TNN interpreters, expects AES-encrypted '.dnn.enc' models that are downloaded from a 'bloops' native component and are not present; ML Kit barcode/face is delegated to GmsCore; Memories face clustering, learned search and voice ML are server-side.

features.name: Haar-cascade face detection (Looksery lens engine)
pipeline: camera frame -> gray (NV21ToRgb shader / YUV planes)
integral image over the uint8 gray frame
LS::FaceDetectorStage loads /HaarCascades/haarcascade_frontalface_alt2.xml (OpenCV cascade parser)
20-stage 20x20 gentle-AdaBoost cascade over a scale ladder
optional LS::Tracking::Face::HybridAccuracyFaceDetector with a downloaded NN detector (not in APK)
face rectangles feed the ERT tracking stages
features.notes: Asset path and engine strings observed in libcamplat (.rodata); OpenCV cascade parser error string 'weight must be real number. (stage %d, tree %d, node %d, rect %d)' confirms OpenCV semantics. JAX reimplementation in reimpl/haar.py.

features.name: ERT landmark tracking (68 landmarks, eyes, denoise, Candide-3, perspective)
pipeline: haar face box -> FaceRegressor.bin (68 landmarks, ConfidenceThreshold 0.76)
-> EyesRegressor.bin -> DenoiseRegressor.bin
-> CandideRegressor.bin (Candide-3 shape id 1) and CandidePespectiveRegressor.bin (shape id 2)
features.notes: Container (LZC v1 + zstd) fully decoded; the five regressor payloads use a proprietary packed binary encoding (tag byte 0x53, mixed int32/IEEE-754 doubles) that is not decoded. Pipeline topology is declared by the shipped Tracking.xml.

features.name: ORB natural-feature tracking
pipeline: FAST-9 corner detection
intensity-centroid orientation (r-10)
steered BRIEF-256 descriptors
Hamming matching + face-region motion tracking
vocabulary tree (branching 20, depth 2) quantisation of descriptors
features.notes: Both trees are bare protobuf messages (1 root + 20 level-1 + 400 leaves, 32-byte centroids each). Decoded in reimpl/looksery_assets.py, used in reimpl/orb.py.

features.name: Scenarium AR deformation and GLES rendering
pipeline: landmark mesh from ERT stages
triangulation.txt / triangulation_with_mouth.txt (118/124 triangles)
face-stretch/liquify displacement (scenarium/facestretchLiquify.glsl)
inpainting_gpu.glsl, guidedFilter, blur, depth and std_vs/std_fs stage shaders
GLES2/GLES3 draw via EGL
features.notes: 275 GLSL assets; liquify formula reimplemented exactly in reimpl/deform.py (pow(clamp(d2/r2, 1/1280, 1), coef)-1 falloff, inverse mapping).

features.name: Snap AI Factory / Cameo (face neutralisation, face+eye segmentation, landmark aligner/refiner, face2face)
pipeline: model file (.dnn.enc) downloaded into the app dir or a bloops component
ModelCrypto.decrypt (AES Cipher, key/IV/algorithm from native internalInit)
native internalInitInterpreter (backend string "MACE")
Bitmap in -> FaceNeutralityResult / segmentation masks / landmarks out
features.notes: All model paths are manifest meta-data; none of these files is packaged. Native component 'bloops' (NLOader) plus manifest tnn_shared_lib=libtnn.so and hexagon_nn skels are also absent. Backend selector literal 'MACE'.

features.name: ML Kit barcode scanning and GmsCore face detection
pipeline: app calls the ML Kit / GMS vision API
executor and models are provided by Google Play services (GmsCore)
no ML Kit native library or model asset is shipped in the APK
features.notes: Manifest advertises com.google.mlkit.vision.DEPENDENCIES=barcode and com.google.android.gms.vision.DEPENDENCIES=face,barcode; only registrar/parcel classes are compiled in. External service contract.

features.name: Snap PreviewCV classical filters (SnapCut, PortraitFilter, SkyFilter, MomentFilter, ManyTargetTracker)
pipeline: OpenCV-based image processing in libcamplat (org_opencv_* JNI, 500+ exports)
SWIG wrappers for SnapCut/PortraitFilter/SkyFilter/MomentFilter/ContextFilter
features.notes: Classical CV (grabcut-style SnapCut, color/bokeh filters, sky segmentation heuristics), no DNN weights observed for these classes.

features.name: Server-side / cloud ML surfaces
pipeline: client uploads features/frames or requests model updates
model bytes fetched at runtime (downloadModel/getRemoteModelStatus)
features.notes: Strings and JNI wrappers present in libclient.so; no local model files. Treated as cloud/server contract.

models.verification: reimpl/verify.py: lzc_container (sizes tile the 383911-byte stream, zstd frame verified, Tracking.xml parsed)

models.verification: reimpl/verify.py: orb_vocabulary_tree (400 leaves, 19/20 level-1 self-map), orb_frame_to_frame_tracking (translation 7,-5 exactly)

models.verification: same decoder as the sharp variant (decoded in reimpl/verify.py orb_vocabulary_tree run)

models.format: obfuscated/encrypted Candide-3 base and 14-action-unit model (5,612-byte shared prefix, entropy 7.04)
plain-text triangle lists over the 68/98 landmark topology (118 / 124 / 21 triangles)
LZC v1 containers holding GLSL, JS, scene.scn, PNG/JPG/PVR textures
models.verification: container index dumped; no model/tensor entry in any bundled lens

models.path: manifest bloops component: *.dnn.enc (FaceNeutrality/Classifier, FaceSegmentation, EyesSegmentation, LandmarksAligner, LandmarksRefiner)

models.jax_reimpl: none (architecture not documented by the app; no weights)

reimplementation.limitations: Implements the shipped classical CV stages (Haar detection with the real 20-stage cascade, ORB FAST/BRIEF tracking with the real vocabulary tree, liquify + triangulated mesh deformation). ERT regressor payloads inside LiteTrackingData_ert.lns use an undecoded proprietary packed format, so landmark regression is architecture-only; Candide-3 files are encrypted. No DNN is implemented because no DNN model ships in the APK; AI Factory .dnn.enc models and the downloaded NN face detector are external contracts. The BRIEF sampling pattern is a documented deterministic Gaussian pattern (OpenCV's exact table is absent).

unknowns: Proprietary ERT regressor binary layout inside LiteTrackingData_ert.lns (tag byte 0x53; mixed int32/IEEE-754 doubles) is not decoded, so landmark weights cannot be run.
candide3reduce / candide3reduce14AU are encrypted or obfuscated (5,612-byte shared prefix); the plaintext vertex/shape/action-unit tables are unavailable.
Which runtime executes the AI Factory .dnn.enc models is inferred from the ctor string 'MACE' plus manifest tnn_shared_lib=libtnn.so, but no bloops/TNN library ships in the APK.
Whether bundled lenses ever use libcamplat's dlopen TFLite path is unknown; no TFLite model ships.

OpenCV 5.0's rewritten xobjdetect evaluator rounds scaled Haar rectangles differently from the classic calc_offsets path embedded in libcamplat; haar.py follows the classic convention (verified at base scale, stage 17/20 on a 184px synthetic face where OpenCV 5 accepts).
Remote/downloaded lens assets (LSRemoteAssetsWrapper, .crypt.glsl) are encrypted with keys not present in the APK.
Memories face clustering, learned search and voice ML model bytes are server-provided; their architectures are not recoverable from this APK.

Exact Android Camera2 capture delegate/session used to feed the lens OES texture is obfuscated (frame dispatcher rk6.a / Hs8.b identified); rotation and resolution source (CameraCharacteristics vs display) is inferred from the frame state.
Haar runtime defaults (scale factor, minimum face size, minFaceInImageRatio) are enforced in native code but the exact numeric defaults were not extracted.
ERT regressor patch size and node/tree layout remain undecoded inside the 0x53-tagged FaceRegressor.bin/EyesRegressor.bin/DenoiseRegressor.bin/Candide* payloads.
ORB robust-estimator/RANSAC parameters and the TrackingManager queue drop policy are internal and were not recovered.

data_pipelines.name: Looksery lens CV: camera OES frame -> Haar face -> ERT landmarks + ORB tracking -> Scenarium AR -> GL texture

trigger.ui: Snap camera preview / capture (camera permission; Camera2 pipeline)
java_entrypoints: defpackage.rk6.a(C7363Og5, S45, float[], int, EnumC2325Emg, long, long, ...) on the GL thread
defpackage.Hs8.b(int texId, int texTarget, long tsNs, float[] m1, float[] m2, EnumC34220qmg) [LensesCameraFeatureProcessingCoreSub]
trigger.lifecycle: init once on an EGL thread (nativeInit); per camera frame; release on teardown (nativeRelease @0x767bcc)

transport.camera_format: GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES (36197) via SurfaceTexture; GL_TEXTURE_2D (3553) for video textures
transport.timestamp: long nanoseconds; TimestampConverter divides by 1e9 and applies a one-time clock-offset correction
transport.matrices: two float[16] 4x4 matrices (texture transform + camera/crop transform)
transport.size: input width/height ints; Size.OPTIMAL_FOR_PROCESSING=600x800; optimizeForProcessing caps larger frames at 480k px (w multiple of 32, h multiple of 4)
transport.rotation: setCameraParams(hFovDeg, vFovDeg, orientationDeg) @0x76bfec; orientation 0/90/180/270; front flag controls mirroring; default 59.0f,-1.0f,0
transport.thread: render/EGL thread; EglContextChecker enforces the owning EGL context; WA4 checks the captured thread id; optional async tracking mode
transport.cadence: one submission per rendered camera frame; TrackingStage InitializeAsync=True; no fixed engine timer; ~30 fps camera inferred

preprocessing: OES/RGBA sample with samplerExternalOES (#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external, uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture)
texture transform + camera matrix applied; resize capped by Size.optimizeForProcessing (<=600x800)
RGBA -> NV21 (common/rgbToNv21Tex, RGBToNV21ConverterSG/GLImpl) and/or uint8 gray (YUV2RGBx)
Haar: integral image of uint8 gray; 20x20 window; scale ladder (kMinFaceScale, minFaceInImageRatio, scaleFactor>1)
ERT: per-face crop warped to the regressor's normalized patch with current shape initialisation (patch size not decoded)
ORB: uint8 gray, FAST-9 + NMS, intensity-centroid orientation r=10, steered BRIEF-256

model_invocation.engine: in-process C++ (libcamplat) + OpenCV 3.1 cascade code + custom LZC/zstd asset loader + GLES2/3
model_invocation.path: LSCoreManagerWrapper::processFrameToTexture -> LS::CoreManager::processFrameToTexture -> LS::TrackingManager::track(LS::ImageArray&&, LS::SharedTexture, TrackingData, Timestamp, ImageProcessingConfig) -> LS::FaceDetectorStage -> LS::TrackingStage graph -> LS::Scenarium
model_invocation.dnn: none shipped: model_assets=0, TFL3 hits=0; MACE/TFLite/NNAPI code paths exist but require a downloaded model (NeuralModelInference cache empty -> libdnn; LENSCORE_NN_FACE_DETECTOR_MODEL absent)

postprocessing: Haar boxes grouped across scales; min face pixel height / max faces configurable (native 0x754424/0x754400)
ERT chain FaceLandmarks68Unblurred (ConfidenceThreshold 0.76) -> Eyes -> Denoise -> FaceLandmarks68 -> Candide (shape 1) -> CandidePerspective (shape 2); FaceLandmarks98 pipeline output
ORB Hamming matching + frame-to-frame translation/inlier vote
landmark mesh 118/124 triangles (observed index range 0..75) piecewise-affine warp
liquify: pow(clamp(d^2/r^2, 1/1280, 1), coef)-1 inverse screen-space sampling
result RGBA texture; drawTexture/drawExternalTexture to app surface or returned texture id
data_pipelines.consumer: Snap camera preview/encoder via GL surface; Scenarium lens rendering; FaceRegionsListener stream; FaceTrackerWrapper float[][] landmarks

external_boundary.type: none for the shipped per-frame path
external_boundary.detail: all stages run locally in libcamplat; the optional NN face detector and lens NN models are downloaded (LENSCORE_NN_FACE_DETECTOR_MODEL, https://perception.sc-cdn.net) and are not packaged

failure_fallback: missing/corrupt cascade -> 'No cascade file found' / 'Invalid classifier cascade'; no detection
missing regressor -> 'Trying to call execute on tracking stage with empty regressor'
NN detector download failure -> 'Failed to download NN face detector model.', falls back to Haar

data_pipelines.name: Google ML Kit barcode scanning + GMS face detection (GmsCore service)

transport.input: camera image via ML Kit InputImage/ImageProxy (YUV_420_888/JPEG) + BarcodeScannerOptions; GMS face Frame (NV21)
transport.crossing: binder IPC to Google Play services (GmsCore)
transport.output: List<Barcode> (bounding boxes, raw bytes, format) / FaceParcel[] (id, type, center, size, eulerY/Z, LandmarkParcel[], smiling/eye-open probabilities)

data_pipelines.preprocessing: done inside GmsCore, not observable in this APK

model_invocation.local: runs on-device in the GmsCore process

data_pipelines.postprocessing: ML Kit/GMS result parcels returned to the app
data_pipelines.consumer: Snap scan/barcode UI and face-driven features

external_boundary.data_crossing: image frames + options to GmsCore; barcode/face results back
external_boundary.local_only: no image leaves the device by this API (inferred); no APK model/executable

failure_fallback: GmsCore missing/outdated -> ML Kit task fails (MlKitException); app must degrade

data_pipelines.name: Snap AI Factory / Cameo deferred DNN (.dnn.enc -> AES -> MACE/TNN interpreter in bloops)

transport.input: Bitmap (ARGB_8888) + float[] landmarks/face rect for inference
transport.model_download: HTTPS via BloopsHttpInterface from Snap CDN (lens-storage.storage.googleapis.com / *.sc-cdn.net); encrypted .dnn.enc bytes saved app-private
transport.decrypt: ModelCrypto.decrypt: AES Cipher; key/IV/algorithm from native bloops internalInit() (not in APK)
transport.to_interpreter: plaintext byte[] -> native internalInitInterpreter(byte[], int modelType, String backend="MACE")

data_pipelines.preprocessing: implemented in bloops (not shipped); FaceNeutrality/FSFaceSegmentation take Bitmap + landmarks

model_invocation.engine: MACE (literal ctor backend) / TNN (tnn_shared_lib=libtnn.so) / NNAPI / TFLite threads; bloops native component via NLOader

getNeutralizedFace returns null if interpreters are 0
